title: Device status
description: POST /v1/devices/me/status: a diagnostic heartbeat (MULTI-DEVICE 8). It reports client-local state the Hub shows but never acts on (D1). Closed input.

rejected_mutation_count.description: Mutations in the client's rejected list, moved aside for the user to see: refused by the Hub (a rejected result), or a capture.commit given up on after repeated retry{missing_blobs} because its originals are gone (D24). The Hub counts open ConflictRecords itself (D1, D24).

last_error.description: The last sync error as the client shows it, on one line.

retry_after.description: When the client will try again.

outbox_bytes.description: Bytes of originals kept for the Outbox (D14).
